task.title: P6-180: Record three one-liner palette and quick-add notes
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-180. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Three palette and quick-add notes that are one-liners each** (was `P6-030d` + `P6-030f` + `P6-069e` + `P6-069i`): `is_mac()` reads the deprecated `navigator.platform` (`palette.rs:1103-1109`) because the non-deprecated `navigator.userAgentData.platform` is not in web-sys — revisit when it lands; hoisting `provide_tree_manage` to the shell means `create_open`/`rename_open`/`menu_target`/`drag` now survive a Catalog ⇄ My-cards mode switch, and verification found this is **stronger than filed** — the dialog stays open *throughout* the switch rather than merely reappearing on return, so the entry's wording needs correcting either way; quick-add candidates go through `search_catalog` (catalog grammar) while `collection_view`'s `q` is a plain name substring, so "answers to the same question" holds only for plain names and a grammar error renders as panel text; and `use_command_nav().expect(...)` is a wasm panic rather than a compile-time guarantee.
